description.summary: This table details the insurer's liability for attorney fees and defense expenses related to legal proceedings and appeals. It outlines conditions for coverage and limitations on the total amount paid.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את אחריות המבטח להחזר הוצאות שכר טרחת עורך דין והוצאות הגנה הקשורות להליכים משפטיים וערעורים. הטבלה מפרטת תנאים לכיסוי ומגבלות על הסכום הכולל ששולם. ניתן לבדוק את הכיסוי עבור הליכים משפטיים, ערעורים, והגבלות אחריות. הטבלה רלוונטית לפוליסת ביטוח לרכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון. הערות חשובות כוללות את הצורך באישור מראש להגשת ערעור, וחוות דעת מפורטת מעורך הדין. סכום ההחזר מוגבל לסכום המצוין בפירוט.

sketch:
24.2 Appeal
The insurer shall indemnify the insured for the fees and defense expenses paid by it to an advocate in respect of an appeal, up to the final instance, including a judgment and/or verdict imposed on the insured in legal proceedings.
The insured shall obtain the insurer 's advance written authorization for filing an appeal as aforementioned.  The insurer shall provide the authorization after receiving a detailed opinion from the advocate who appeared before the court against which the appeal is sought, in terms of which in his opinion, there is a pertinent basis and good chances of the appeal succeeding as aforementioned.
24.3 Limitation of liability
The insurer 's liability in accordance with paragraph 24.1.2 above in respect of any accidental occurrence and in total for the entire insurance period shall be limited to the sum noted in this paragraph in the specification.

טבלה: החזר הוצאות שכר טרחת עורך דין
This table details the insurer's liability for attorney fees and defense expenses related to legal proceedings and appeals. It outlines conditions for coverage and limitations on the total amount paid.
ממדים: type of legal action / condition, insurer liability / requirements

24.2 Appeal
The insurer shall indemnify the insured for the fees and defense expenses paid by it to an advocate in respect of an appeal, up to the final instance, including a judgment and/or verdict imposed on the insured in legal proceedings.
The insured shall obtain the insurer 's advance written authorization for filing an appeal as aforementioned.  The insurer shall provide the authorization after receiving a detailed opinion from the advocate who appeared before the court against which the appeal is sought, in terms of which in his opinion, there is a pertinent basis and good chances of the appeal succeeding as aforementioned.
24.3 Limitation of liability
The insurer 's liability in accordance with paragraph 24.1.2 above in respect of any accidental occurrence and in total for the entire insurance period shall be limited to the sum noted in this paragraph in the specification.
